=SELECT
  d.id AS draft_id,
  d.idea_id,
  d.keyword_cluster_id,
  d.title,
  d.meta_title,
  d.meta_description,
  d.tags,
  d.content_markdown,
  d.status AS draft_status,
  d.word_count,
  d.featured_image_url,
  d.featured_image_alt,
  d.featured_image_prompt,
  d.qa_passed,
  d.created_at,
  d.updated_at,
  i.idea_title,
  i.categoria AS idea_categoria,
  i.status AS idea_status,
  k.project_name,
  k.cluster_name,
  k.keyword_principal,
  k.keywords_secundarias
FROM drafts d
JOIN ideas i ON d.idea_id = i.id
JOIN keywords k ON d.keyword_cluster_id = k.id
WHERE COALESCE(d.content_markdown, '') <> ''
{{ $json.body?.force ? '' : "  AND (d.featured_image_url IS NULL OR d.featured_image_url = '')" }}
{{ $json.body?.include_published ? '' : "  AND d.status IN ('draft','review','approved')" }}
{{ $json.body?.draft_id ? "  AND d.id = '" + $json.body.draft_id.replace(/'/g, "''") + "'" : '' }}
{{ $json.body?.idea_id ? "  AND d.idea_id = '" + $json.body.idea_id.replace(/'/g, "''") + "'" : '' }}
{{ $json.body?.keyword_cluster_id ? "  AND d.keyword_cluster_id = '" + $json.body.keyword_cluster_id.replace(/'/g, "''") + "'" : '' }}
{{ $json.body?.project_name ? "  AND k.project_name = '" + $json.body.project_name.replace(/'/g, "''") + "'" : '' }}
ORDER BY d.updated_at DESC NULLS LAST, d.created_at DESC
{{ $json.body?.limit ? "LIMIT " + $json.body.limit : "LIMIT 3" }}

=UPDATE drafts
SET
  featured_image_url = $1,
  featured_image_alt = $2,
  featured_image_prompt = $3,
  updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = $4
RETURNING id, featured_image_url, featured_image_alt, featured_image_prompt, updated_at

=INSERT INTO jobs_log (job_name, job_type, status, related_keyword_id, related_idea_id, related_draft_id, started_at, completed_at, duration_ms, input_data, output_data)\nVALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7::timestamp, $8::timestamp, $9, $10::jsonb, $11::jsonb)\nRETURNING id, job_name, status, created_at
